scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Cycle Sahayata Yojana
description:
The Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Cycle Sahayata Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India. 

This scheme was launched on 1st March 2021. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to unorganized sector workers. 

The scheme specifically targets those who rely on cycles for their livelihood. 

This includes individuals such as daily wage laborers, street vendors, and other informal workers. 

The government aims to support these workers by providing them with a cycle. 

The assistance under this scheme is intended to enhance their mobility. 

This, in turn, is expected to improve their income-generating capacity. 

The scheme aims to distribute cycles to approximately 1 lakh beneficiaries. 

Each beneficiary will receive a financial assistance of ₹10,000. 

This amount is intended to cover the cost of purchasing a cycle. 

The scheme is part of the broader initiative to uplift the unorganized sector. 

The government recognizes the significant contribution of these workers to the economy. 

Eligibility for this scheme is specifically defined. 

Applicants must be residents of Madhya Pradesh. 

They must belong to the unorganized sector. 

The age limit for applicants is set at 18 years and above. 

There is no upper age limit specified for eligibility. 

Income criteria are also established for this scheme. 

The annual income of the applicants should not exceed ₹1 lakh. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the benefits reach the most needy. 

Educational qualifications are not a prerequisite for this scheme. 

The application process is designed to be straightforward. 

Interested applicants must visit the official website of the Madhya Pradesh government. 

They need to fill out the application form available online. 

The application form requires basic personal details. 

Applicants must provide proof of their unorganized sector employment. 

This can include documents such as identity cards or work certificates. 

Aadhar card details are also necessary for the application. 

Once the form is completed, it must be submitted online. 

After submission, applicants will receive an acknowledgment. 

This acknowledgment will contain a unique application number. 

The government has set a timeline for the disbursement of benefits. 

Once the applications are processed, the selected beneficiaries will be notified. 

The cycle assistance amount will be transferred directly to the beneficiaries' bank accounts. 

This transfer is expected to occur within 30 days of approval. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Labour. 

They are responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement. 

The government has established a dedicated helpline for queries. 

The helpline number is 0755-2700800. 

This number can be used for assistance regarding the application process. 

The scheme also aims to empower women in the unorganized sector. 

Women workers are encouraged to apply for this assistance. 

The government aims to promote gender equality through this initiative. 

Statistical data indicates that a significant portion of the unorganized workforce consists of women. 

This scheme is expected to directly benefit around 50,000 women. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for this scheme. 

This budget will facilitate the purchase and distribution of cycles. 

The scheme is expected to reduce transportation costs for workers. 

It will also enhance their access to markets and job opportunities. 

The government has partnered with local manufacturers for cycle procurement. 

This partnership aims to support local businesses while providing quality cycles. 

The scheme is part of a larger vision to improve the livelihoods of informal workers. 

The government has also launched awareness campaigns about the scheme. 

These campaigns are aimed at educating potential beneficiaries. 

The awareness programs are conducted through various media channels. 

Community meetings are also organized to disseminate information. 

The scheme is expected to create a ripple effect in local economies. 

By improving mobility, workers can access better job opportunities. 

This, in turn, can lead to increased earnings and improved living standards. 

The government is monitoring the implementation of the scheme closely. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate its impact. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is also collected for future improvements. 

The Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Cycle Sahayata Yojana represents a significant step. 

It aims to uplift the unorganized sector in Madhya Pradesh. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to social welfare. 

It seeks to empower the most vulnerable sections of society. 

By providing cycles, the government is facilitating economic growth. 

This initiative is expected to have long-term benefits for the state's economy. 

The scheme is a testament to the importance of supporting informal workers. 

They play a crucial role in the overall economic framework of the state. 

The Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Cycle Sahayata Yojana is a vital intervention. 

It addresses the immediate needs of unorganized sector workers. 

The scheme is designed to foster self-reliance among beneficiaries. 

By enhancing mobility, the government is enabling better livelihoods. 

This initiative is a clear example of targeted welfare policies. 

It aims to create a more equitable society. 

The scheme is expected to be a model for similar initiatives in other states. 

Overall, the Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Cycle Sahayata Yojana is a comprehensive welfare scheme. 

It combines financial assistance with a focus on empowerment. 

The scheme is a crucial part of Madhya Pradesh's development agenda. 

It highlights the government's proactive approach to social issues. 

The Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Cycle Sahayata Yojana is a significant step forward. 

It aims to uplift the unorganized workforce in the state. 

This scheme is expected to bring about meaningful change in the lives of many.
